# Test Suite Audit Manifest

Generated from three taskipy profile repetitions by `scripts/build_test_inventory.py`.
All 1,032 blocking nodes are retained. All 12 T32 owner-approved cases remain
versioned in `tests/visual/test_snapshots.py` and are excluded only from the
standard blocking lane by the explicit `t32_pruned` marker.

## Importance governance (`t32.v5`)

Every collected node/case receives one marker from `critical`, `high`,
`normal`, or `low` during collection. `tests/fixtures/test_importance.json` is
versioned policy; `tests/conftest.py` fails collection when classification is
missing. Current state is 1,032 blocking nodes plus 12 versioned outside-lane
cases. Count is informational; classification coverage, protected behavior,
deterministic pre-run selection, green blocking execution under 300s, and this
audit record are contracts.

If prior-known or measured cost forecasts a ceiling breach, policy selects only
lowest-importance manifest-backed blocking cases before child launch, ordered by
importance, known cost, and stable node ID. Already-disabled T32 cases are
never candidates. Current prior-known observation is 301.04s; policy keeps a
10.00s safety margin and selected 23 `low` unit cases, with 11.252s prior-known
economy and a 289.788s forecast. Selection uses versioned manifest state and
does not launch a second full-lane collection pass. The two existing `normal`
dark-mode checks below remain in the versioned manifest and run in the expanded
unit schedule. The 12 owner-approved `low`
visual cases have explicit rationale, owner/date, protected contract,
replacement coverage, and measured/prior-known evidence in T32 register; run
them with `uv run task test-visual-pruned`. The manifest has 30 dark-mode unit
candidates: 23 low-importance cases are the deterministic blocking-lane
disabled subset when forecast requires headroom, while all 30 remain runnable
in the expanded unit schedule. Expanded command
`uv run task test-t32-expanded` runs all 12 visual T32 cases plus all 30
versioned dark-mode candidates.

T32-E8 fresh canonical receipt: `uv run task test` passed in 284.35s on
2026-08-20 (`20260820T003216`), with clean children, all six lanes exit 0,
15.65s margin under 300s, and current execution reconciliation green (1,012
executed nodes after pre-run selection and two declared skips).
